name: tk-tkl
description: Charlottendal TKL och en separat LocoNet-anläggningssimulator

scripts.import:trakvista: python3 scripts/import-source.py --source stations/trakvista/Trakvista.xml --out stations/trakvista/data/source && python3 scripts/import-layout.py stations/trakvista/Trakvista.xml --panel Träkvista --station stations/trakvista/station.json --out stations/trakvista/data/panel.json && python3 scripts/import-logixng.py stations/trakvista && node scripts/make-station-profile.mjs stations/trakvista
scripts.verify:trakvista: python3 scripts/import-source.py --source stations/trakvista/Trakvista.xml --out stations/trakvista/data/source --check >/dev/null && python3 scripts/import-layout.py stations/trakvista/Trakvista.xml --panel Träkvista --station stations/trakvista/station.json --out stations/trakvista/data/panel.json --check && python3 scripts/import-logixng.py stations/trakvista --check && node scripts/make-station-profile.mjs stations/trakvista --check
